description:
The Pope recently stated that Christians should not try to convert unbelievers and that anyone who does is not a true disciple of Jesus. Listen to pastor Mark Finley give a biblical response to this recent statement from Pope Francis.

This video is a clip from the Ask Pastor Mark Live show which broadcasts live each Saturday on the HopeLives365 Facebook Page
